state_background_check.value: Oregon does not disqualify convicted felons from running for U.S. House or Senate. Oregon Constitution Art. IV, Section 8 bars a felon whose sentence is not complete from serving as a state legislative Senator or Representative, but that provision is textually confined to the Oregon Legislative Assembly (state Senator/Representative) — it does not mention Congress and does not appear in the article of the constitution governing elections generally. No separate Oregon statute or the state's official Candidate Manual imposes a felony bar on federal (U.S. House/Senate) candidates. Any state attempt to add such a qualification for Congress would in any event be preempted under U.S. Term Limits, Inc. v. Thornton (1995), which holds states cannot add qualifications for Congress beyond the U.S. Constitution's own age/citizenship/residency requirements.
state_background_check.snippet: Or. Const. Art. IV, § 8(4): "A person is not eligible to be elected as a Senator or Representative if that person has been convicted of a felony and has not completed the sentence received for the conviction prior to the date that person would take office if elected." [Located within Article IV, the Legislative Department article governing the Oregon Legislative Assembly — not Congress.]

platform.value: Supports an all-of-the-above border approach using physical barriers where appropriate, sensors and drones, cybersecurity, and a properly staffed Border Patrol
platform.snippet: I will support an all-of-the-above approach to border security using physical barriers where appropriate, advanced sensors and drones, strong cybersecurity, and a properly staffed Border Patrol empowered to enforce the law.

platform.value: Would close asylum loopholes and prevent the return of catch-and-release policies
platform.snippet: I will work to close asylum loopholes, prevent the return of catch-and-release policies, and ensure that our laws never again create incentives for mass illegal entry.

platform.value: Supports using federal law-enforcement, intelligence, financial and national-security tools to dismantle drug and human trafficking cartels
platform.snippet: I support using every appropriate federal law-enforcement, intelligence, financial, and national-security tool to dismantle these criminal networks.

platform.value: Says noncitizens who commit serious violent crimes, traffic drugs or people, or engage in gang violence should be removed, with state and local cooperation in lawful federal efforts
platform.snippet: Noncitizens who commit serious violent crimes, engage in human or major drug trafficking, participate in gang violence, or otherwise pose a serious threat to our communities, should be removed.

platform.value: Rejects indiscriminate mass deportation as neither realistic nor constructive
platform.snippet: Indiscriminate mass deportation is neither a realistic nor constructive solution.

platform.value: Supports a one-time opportunity for long-settled, non-criminal residents to earn lawful status, conditioned on registration, background and national-security checks, biometrics, resolving tax obligations, and demonstrating employment and self-sufficiency
platform.snippet: I support a one-time opportunity to earn lawful status for long-settled, non-criminal residents who meet strict requirements.

platform.value: States the earned status is not automatic citizenship, and that anyone entering illegally after the reform should not receive the same opportunity
platform.snippet: This is not automatic citizenship. It is a path to lawful status with accountability.

platform.value: Would streamline lawful immigration, modernize processing and fraud detection, reduce bureaucratic delays, and protect family unity
platform.snippet: I will work to streamline lawful immigration, modernize processing and fraud detection, reduce unnecessary bureaucratic delays, and protect family unity.

platform.value: Supports legal workforce immigration pathways, including merit-based and temporary-worker programs, so employers can meet labor needs while workers are screened, authorized and protected from exploitation
platform.snippet: I support legal, efficient workforce immigration pathways that allow employers to meet legitimate labor needs while ensuring workers are screened, authorized to work, and protected from exploitation. That includes sensible merit-based immigration and temporary-worker programs that respond to actual workforce shortages.

platform.value: Says Oregon agriculture, forestry and wildfire management, construction, manufacturing, healthcare and hospitality depend on reliable access to workers when Americans are unavailable
platform.snippet: Here in Oregon, agriculture, forestry and wildfire management, construction, manufacturing, healthcare, hospitality, and other critical industries depend on reliable access to workers when Americans are not available to fill those jobs.

platform.value: Supports a modern asylum system beginning claims through secure processes before dangerous journeys, using biometric and identity verification, rapidly screening fraudulent claims, and giving legitimate applicants timely decisions
platform.snippet: I support a modern asylum system that allows claims to begin through secure processes before migrants make dangerous journeys to our border whenever possible, uses biometric and identity verification, rapidly screens fraudulent claims, and provides legitimate applicants with timely decisions.

platform.value: Would create a fast, accurate national employment-verification system, protecting employers who follow the rules and holding accountable those who knowingly exploit illegal labor
platform.snippet: We need a fast, accurate national employment-verification system that allows employers to determine whether someone is legally authorized to work. Employers who follow the rules should be protected. Those who knowingly exploit illegal labor should be held accountable.

platform.value: Rejects the choice between tolerating illegal immigration and deporting millions who have built lives in the country, arguing both border security and humane treatment are possible
platform.snippet: We can secure our border and treat people with humanity. We can enforce our laws and acknowledge the consequences of decades of government failure. We can remove dangerous criminals while giving long-settled, law-abiding people a rigorous opportunity to come into legal compliance.

platform.value: Would work to remove bureaucratic obstacles in the VA system so veterans' benefits are protected and they receive care on time
platform.snippet: Every day that I am in Congress, I will fight to remove obstacles and ensure our veteran benefits are protected and that veterans receive the care and attention they have earned.

platform.value: Would dedicate a veteran on her Oregon congressional staff full-time to serving veteran constituents, including homeless veterans
platform.snippet: Back home in Oregon, I will have a veteran on my congressional staff who is dedicated 100 percent to working with me to serve all of my veteran constituents, including our forgotten homeless veterans.

platform.value: Identifies housing obstacles as a problem facing many veterans
platform.snippet: Tragically, many veterans face housing obstacles as well.

platform.value: Would ensure law enforcement and emergency responders have the authority and resources to do their job, from Customs and Border Patrol to local sheriffs, police and district attorneys
platform.snippet: It is my goal to ensure they have the necessary authority and resources to do their job effectively, from Customs and Border Patrol to our local sheriffs, police, and district attorneys.

platform.value: Would not support federal funding for cities she describes as soft-on-crime or that defund police, and says officials who refuse to enforce laws should themselves be held accountable and replaced
platform.snippet: Public officials who refuse to enforce our laws and hold criminals accountable must be held accountable themselves and swiftly replaced with officials who will. I will not support federal funding for soft-on-crime cities or cities that defund the police and leave Americans vulnerable.

platform.value: Ties neighborhood safety to securing the border and stopping the flow of fentanyl, P2P methamphetamines and other drugs into Oregon
platform.snippet: To ensure safe neighborhoods in Congressional District 4, we must secure our nation’s border and stop the relentless flow of fentanyl, P2P methamphetamines, and other deadly drugs into Oregon.

platform.value: Argues ending cartel control of the border would stop drug distribution and human trafficking she links to addiction, homelessness and crime
platform.snippet: By ending cartel control of our borders and preventing criminals from illegally entering our cities and other communities, we will stop the delivery and distribution of deadly drugs, human trafficking, and other abhorrent cartel activity that is fueling addiction, homelessness, and the crime wave overwhelming our communities.

platform.value: Says homelessness is not a single problem and cannot have a single solution, distinguishing addiction, veteran homelessness, severe mental illness and housing cost
platform.snippet: Homelessness is not a single problem, so it cannot have a single solution. A person struggling with addiction requires a different response than a veteran experiencing homelessness, a person with severe mental illness, or a family working full-time but unable to afford housing.

platform.value: Would expand treatment capacity for addiction and mental illness, including medically assisted treatment, recovery housing and long-term support
platform.snippet: Expand treatment capacity for addiction and mental illness, including medically assisted treatment, recovery housing, and long-term support.

platform.value: Would require publicly funded homelessness, addiction and mental health programs to be measured by outcomes rather than intentions
platform.snippet: Require accountability for publicly funded homelessness, addiction, and mental health programs by measuring outcomes, not intentions. Taxpayers deserve to know which programs are helping people achieve recovery, housing, and independence.

platform.value: Supports deflection and diversion programs connecting people to treatment before they enter the criminal justice system, while maintaining consequences
platform.snippet: Support deflection and diversion programs that connect people to treatment, while maintaining accountability and meaningful consequences, before they enter the criminal justice system.

platform.value: Would enforce laws against public camping, drug use, theft and disorder while ensuring adequate shelter and treatment options exist
platform.snippet: Enforce laws against public camping, drug use, theft, and disorder while ensuring adequate shelter and treatment options are available.

platform.value: Would increase housing supply by reducing regulatory barriers, streamlining permitting and encouraging affordable workforce housing
platform.snippet: Increase housing supply by reducing regulatory barriers, streamlining permitting, and encouraging affordable workforce housing.

platform.value: Supports responsible forest management and sustainable timber production on public lands to create family-wage jobs and generate county revenue for public safety, roads, schools and treatment facilities
platform.snippet: I also support responsible forest management and sustainable timber production on public lands, creating family-wage jobs while generating revenue for counties, public safety, roads, schools, treatment programs and treatment facilities.

platform.value: Would expand support for veterans experiencing homelessness and ensure they receive earned benefits and services
platform.snippet: Expand support for veterans experiencing homelessness and ensure they receive the benefits and services they earned.

platform.value: Would judge homelessness policy by whether it helps people recover, become self-sufficient and return to stable housing, and stop funding programs that do not
platform.snippet: We should judge every homelessness policy by one question: Is it helping people recover from their actual problem, become self-sufficient, and return to stable housing and productive lives? Whenever the answer is no, we should stop funding that failure and invest in solutions that work instead.

platform.value: Would end permitting costs, building regulations, local codes and land-use restrictions she says stifle new construction
platform.snippet: I support ending prohibitive and inflationary policies that stifle new construction with excessive permitting costs, building regulations, city and county codes, bureaucratic red tape, and outdated land-use restrictions imposed by the government itself.

platform.value: Wants the federal government to lift housing restrictions, arguing they price working people out of home ownership
platform.snippet: I want to be part of the common sense conservative majority in Congress that ensures the federal government does its part to lift housing restrictions.

platform.value: Would champion responsible forest management with tribal co-stewardship, sustainable timber harvests, and proactive fuel-load removal to reduce catastrophic wildfires
platform.snippet: As your Congresswoman, I will champion responsible forest management grounded in co-stewardship with tribal nations, sustainable timber harvests, and proactive removal of fuel loads that drive catastrophic wildfires.

platform.value: Would require the Forest Service and BLM to rapidly suppress fires or immediately authorize state, local and private entities to do so
platform.snippet: The U.S. Forest Service and Bureau of Land Management should be required to rapidly suppress fires or immediately authorize state, local, and private entities ready to protect our forests and communities.

platform.value: Would cut regulation affecting farmers and ranchers and defend a resilient "Made in America" food supply
platform.snippet: I will cut the bureaucratic red tape and impractical restrictions harming our farmers and ranchers. I believe in independence, innovation, and the right to thrive. I will defend a resilient “Made in America” food supply and safeguard farmers’ ability to farm and provide affordable, healthy choices for consumers.

platform.value: Would remove federal barriers blocking development of the Oregon International Port of Coos Bay
platform.snippet: I will also work relentlessly to remove federal barriers blocking development of the Oregon International Port of Coos Bay—an untapped economic engine with the potential to serve the entire Pacific.

platform.value: Would invest in durable infrastructure and address housing and childcare shortages to attract a skilled workforce in coastal communities
platform.snippet: Strengthening our coastal communities means investing in durable infrastructure, addressing housing and childcare shortages, and attracting the skilled workforce needed to power long-term growth.

platform.value: Would restore active forest management including thinning overcrowded stands and removing dangerous fuel loads and ladder fuels
platform.snippet: Thinning overcrowded stands and removing dangerous fuel loads and ladder fuels.

platform.value: Supports sustainable-yield timber harvests and prompt, responsible salvage after fires
platform.snippet: Sustainable-yield timber harvests and prompt, responsible salvage after fires.

platform.value: Supports prescribed fire and tribal cultural burning where they can be used safely
platform.snippet: Prescribed fire and tribal cultural burning where they can be used safely.

platform.value: Would protect mature and old-growth trees through active management of surrounding fuels
platform.snippet: Protection of mature and old-growth trees through active management of surrounding fuels.

platform.value: Would maintain essential roads, trails, water sources and evacuation routes
platform.snippet: Maintaining essential roads, trails, water sources, and evacuation routes.

platform.value: Says federal tree plantations should be sustainably managed for renewable timber and jobs, with selected overcrowded plantations converted to more diverse forests where restoration is the better use
platform.snippet: Federal tree plantations should be sustainably managed to produce renewable timber, materials for American homes, and family-wage jobs. Where restoration is the better use, selected overcrowded plantations should be converted into healthier, more diverse forests that can better withstand wildfire, insects, and disease.

platform.value: Would demand transparency on wildfire response decisions, contract terms, expenditures and fires that escape initial attack
platform.snippet: I will demand transparency regarding response decisions, contract terms, expenditures, and fires that escape initial attack. Our priority must be protecting lives, communities, and forests—not sustaining an increasingly expensive and lucrative wildfire industry.

platform.value: Submitted public comment supporting rescission of the 2001 Roadless Rule, saying it would let local managers plan access for wildfire response, restoration and recreation while retaining environmental review
platform.snippet: I have already submitted public comment supporting rescission of the one-size-fits-all 2001 Roadless Rule. Rescission would not automatically authorize logging or road construction. It would allow local forest managers to determine where carefully planned access is needed for wildfire response, restoration, recreation, and public safety, while retaining environmental review and protections for sensitive areas.

platform.value: Says federal forest management should honor sustained-yield and revenue-sharing requirements for O&C lands, supporting county schools, roads, law enforcement and emergency services
platform.snippet: Federal forest management should also honor the sustained-yield and revenue-sharing requirements governing O&C lands, generating dependable support for county schools, roads, law enforcement, and emergency services.

platform.value: Says responsible management can create family-wage jobs in forestry, trucking, firefighting, reforestation, milling, manufacturing and equipment maintenance
platform.snippet: Responsible management can create family-wage jobs in forestry, trucking, firefighting, reforestation, milling, manufacturing, and equipment maintenance.

platform.value: Would support a Parents' Bill of Rights providing full access to curricula, clear reporting on school performance, and school choice
platform.snippet: As your Congresswoman, I will support a Parents’ Bill of Rights to ensure real transparency and accountability: full access to curricula, clear reporting on school performance, and genuine school choice.

platform.value: Would return parents, teachers and local education partners to the center of decision-making rather than a one-size-fits-all system
platform.snippet: We must return parents, teachers, and local education partners to the center of decision-making.

platform.value: Says students are increasingly failing to meet minimum proficiency in reading, writing and math despite rising spending
platform.snippet: Students are increasingly failing to meet minimum proficiency in reading, writing, and math. This shortfall imposes significant costs on families and employers and leaves young people unprepared for productive, independent lives.

platform.value: Would champion private-sector job creation, especially for small and medium-sized businesses and the skilled trades
platform.snippet: As your Congresswoman, I will champion sustainable private-sector job creation, especially for small and medium-sized businesses and the skilled trades.

platform.value: Would support policies rebuilding American manufacturing, lowering the cost of goods and improving affordability
platform.snippet: I will support policies that rebuild American manufacturing, lower the cost of goods, and improve affordability so Americans can live and work with pride and dignity.

platform.value: Would cut regulations, fix permitting systems and reduce taxation so Americans keep more of what they earn
platform.snippet: We must cut excessive regulations, fix broken permitting systems, and reduce punitive taxation so Americans can keep more of what they earn and reinvest in their communities.

platform.value: Would direct federal resources toward reducing property crime and theft she says raise prices, inflate insurance costs and force businesses to close
platform.snippet: I support directing federal resources toward dramatically reducing property crime and theft that raise prices, inflate insurance costs, and force businesses to close.

platform.value: Would fight to end tax-and-spend policies she says fuel inflation, undermine affordability and increase the national debt
platform.snippet: In Congress, I will fight to end reckless, wasteful tax-and-spend policies coming out of Washington that fuel inflation, undermine affordability, increase the national debt, and place the American Dream out of reach for too many.

platform.value: Would oppose limits on Americans' freedom to choose energy sources, and opposes arbitrary government bans, penalties or prohibitive taxes on energy options
platform.snippet: As your Congresswoman, I will oppose ongoing attacks on Americans’ freedom to choose their energy sources. The first-world nation we currently enjoy must continue to ensure access to an array of reliable and affordable energy options without the threat of arbitrary government bans, penalties, or prohibitive taxes.

platform.value: Says consumers and businesses, not government, should decide when and how to adopt alternative energy, free from forced transitions
platform.snippet: Consumers and businesses—not distant bureaucrats—should decide when and how to adopt alternative energy options, free from prohibitive costs or forced transitions.

platform.value: Supports an all-of-the-above strategy developing cleaner energy choices, protecting energy infrastructure and ending reliance on hostile and unreliable nations
platform.snippet: the government should pursue an “all of the above” energy strategy that strives to develop scientifically based, cleaner energy choices, protects our energy infrastructure, and ends reliance on sources of energy from hostile and unreliable nations.

platform.value: Commits to publishing all of her votes and the reasons behind them for the public to see
platform.snippet: When elected, I commit to sharing all of my votes and reasons behind them for all the public to see.

platform.value: Would apply an investigative approach and knowledge of the law to expose wasteful spending
platform.snippet: I will apply my experienced investigative eye and knowledge of the law to expose wasteful spending.

platform.value: Would fight to eliminate discrimination, corruption and cronyism and expose conflicts of interest
platform.snippet: I will fight to eliminate discrimination, corruption, and cronyism, expose conflicts of interest

platform.value: Says peace through strength is the proven strategy for deterring aggression and preventing conflict
platform.snippet: Peace through strength remains the proven strategy for deterring aggression, preventing conflict, and securing lasting peace and prosperity.

platform.value: Would maintain America's technological edge, reinforce readiness, and invest in modern capabilities especially cyber and missile defense
platform.snippet: That means maintaining our technological edge, reinforcing readiness, and investing in modern capabilities—especially cyber capabilities and missile defense—to meet rapidly evolving 21st-century threats.

platform.value: Supports allies' right to defend themselves but opposes unlimited foreign aid without strict oversight, demanding transparency on how taxpayer money is used
platform.snippet: I support the right of our allies to defend themselves from terrorists and hostile regimes, but I oppose unlimited foreign aid without strict oversight. No taxpayer dollars should be spent without accountability.

platform.value: Supports requiring photo ID to vote, updated and accurate voter registration records, and vote tallying by certified American-made machines and software
platform.snippet: This includes requiring a photo ID to vote, updated and accurate voter registration records, and vote tallying by controlled, certified machines and software that are made in America.

platform.value: Supports Oregon's citizen initiative process as a check on government overreach
platform.snippet: I strongly support Oregon’s treasured citizen initiative process that serves as an essential check on government overreach and ensures that the voices of everyday Oregonians—too often overlooked—are heard.

platform.value: Calls China the foremost strategic adversary and says the government must remain vigilant and aggressive in maintaining strength and readiness
platform.snippet: China is our foremost strategic adversary, and our government must remain vigilant and aggressive in maintaining strength and readiness every moment of every day.

platform.value: Would hold the Chinese Communist Party accountable and end technology theft, cyber warfare, trade exploitation, currency manipulation, institutional infiltration and military aggression
platform.snippet: I will work to hold the Chinese Communist Party and its leadership accountable for their hostile, invasive actions and end their technology theft, cyber warfare, trade exploitation, currency manipulation, institutional infiltration, and military aggression.

platform.value: Would ensure Israel and its enemies never doubt that America will stand for Israel and against terrorism
platform.snippet: When elected, I will ensure that Israel and its enemies never doubt that America will stand for Israel and against terrorism.

platform.value: Supports all nations defending themselves against attacks on their people and sovereign lands
platform.snippet: America should and must defend herself against all enemies, and I support all nations in defending themselves against attacks on their people and their sovereign lands.

bio_summary.value: I am an outsider running for Congress because my kids and yours need a fighter in Washington who will deliver commonsense policies with real results. I served our nation for 30 years in the United States Air Force, the Air Force Reserve, and the Oregon Air National Guard, retiring with the rank of Colonel. For 20 of those years, I served as a lawyer with the Judge Advocate General’s Corps in various locations and deployments around the world, developing policy, handling investigations, managing litigation, and advising senior commanders on military justice and ethics. I made Oregon my home in 1995 when I left active duty to attend law school at Willamette University in Salem. I am a single mother who raised my twin boys for the past 22 years in the heart of the Fourth Congressional District in Eugene, Oregon.

From her union roots, to her leadership in Oregon's government, she always puts working people first. Join the Movement We can’t win this fight if we don’t join together and fight back against the billionaires. Be part of our movement and chip in today. Click on an amount to get started and contribute to support Val Hoyle. If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. $5 $25 $50 $100 $250 OTHER Sign up to Get Involved Get a Lawn Sign Help us Spread the Word Key Issues Val Always Fights for Oregon Reproductive Healthcare Make health care affordable and protect access to reproductive health care. Working Families Val helped pass paid sick leave – and is a champion of apprenticeship programs. Our Environment Val expanded Oregon’s Clean Fuels program to reduce carbon emissions. In Congress, she’ll continue working to transition us to a clean energy future. Oregon Workers Val increased the state’s minimum wage. Gun Safety Val sponsored and passed a law requiring universal background checks for all firearm sales. Voting Rights Protect our best-in-the-nation Vote by Mail system from federal attacks. See Val's Priorities ' Endorsements Val is proud to have the support of Oregon’s elected officials, community organizations, and working families. Senator Bernie Sanders Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez Rep. Peter DeFazio, retired Planned Parenthood Action Fund Oregon Labor Federation (AFL-CIO) League of Conservation Voters Action Fund See more Endorsements Val Hoyle for Congress Val Hoyle’s record of standing up for Oregon’s hardworking families and small businesses stems from a lifetime of experience. Growing up in a family with union roots that go back three generations, Val’s firefighter father taught her that you have to work hard for everything you get — but you also have to hold the ladder so the next person has the opportunity to climb. Before serving in Congress, Val was Oregon's Labor Commissioner; she fought to ensure that Oregon workers are paid the wages and benefits they are owed under the law, oversaw enforcement of civil rights and housing discrimination protections for Oregonians, and had jurisdiction over apprenticeship programs that provide workforce training across the state.

enacted_laws.title: To amend the Siletz Reservation Act to address the hunting, fishing, trapping, and animal gathering rights of the Confederated Tribes of Siletz Indians, and for other purposes.
enacted_laws.summary: This act provides a process by which the Confederated Tribes of Siletz Indians and Oregon may negotiate to amend or replace the existing agreement defining the tribe's hunting, fishing, trapping, and animal gathering rights. The current agreement, which was made effective by a May 2, 1980, consent decree by the U.S. District Court for the District of Oregon, serves as the exclusive and final determination of the tribe's hunting, fishing, trapping, and gathering rights. This act instead allows an April 22, 1980, agreement between the United States, Oregon, and the tribe (known as the Siletz Agreement) to define the tribe's rights until and unless it is amended or replaced upon mutual agreement of the tribe and Oregon (with specified limitations regarding a new agreement). The act allows the tribe and Oregon to return to the U.S. District Court for the District of Oregon to request the modification or termination of the May 2, 1980, consent decree.
